title: HUSH GARDEN
description: HUSH GARDEN is a spa and relaxation garden concept under a glass roof, designed around quiet rest. Leaf-shaped cocoons sit apart from one another between planting and water, so each guest has a sheltered, private place to rest while the hall stays open and connected. A stream, a waterfall pool and a timber walkway give the space its structure and a calm focal point. The palette sets glossy veined leaf surfaces against matte cream textile, stone, water and wood. Daylight through the glass sets the overall tone, and warm lanterns add a softer ambient glow.
role: Concept design, creative direction and visual storytelling - Mariia Andriiuk.
